purpose: Test the submission of a student leave application
preconditions: A student logs in to the OAP Fusion ERP system, has a valid leave request template, and is authorized to submit it
action_or_input: Submit the leave application via the OAP Fusion ERP system using the provided template
expected_result: The leave application is submitted successfully, and the student receives an acknowledgment of receipt

purpose: Test the attachment of supporting documents for a medical/academic leave application
preconditions: A student logs in to the OAP Fusion ERP system, has a valid leave request template, and is authorized to submit it
action_or_input: Attach supporting documents to the leave application using the provided file upload interface
expected_result: The supporting documents are attached successfully, and the leave application is submitted successfully

purpose: Test the automatic routing of a leave request to assigned HoD
preconditions: A student logs in to the OAP Fusion ERP system, has a valid leave request template, and is authorized to submit it
action_or_input: Submit the leave application via the OAP Fusion ERP system using the provided template, and ensure that the leave request is routed to the correct HoD
expected_result: The leave request is automatically routed to the assigned HoD, and the student receives an acknowledgment of receipt

purpose: Test the HoD review of a submitted leave application
preconditions: A student logs in to the OAP Fusion ERP system, has a valid leave request template, and is authorized to submit it
action_or_input: Submit the leave application via the OAP Fusion ERP system using the provided template, and ensure that the HoD reviews the leave request
expected_result: The HoD reviews the leave request and approves it, and the student receives an acknowledgment of receipt

purpose: Test the HoD approval or rejection decision recording with remarks
preconditions: A student logs in to the OAP Fusion ERP system, has a valid leave request template, and is authorized to submit it
action_or_input: Submit the leave application via the OAP Fusion ERP system using the provided template, and ensure that the HoD makes a decision on the leave request
expected_result: The HoD makes a decision on the leave request, and the decision record is recorded with remarks, and the student receives an acknowledgment of receipt

purpose: Test the student viewing current status of own leave requests
preconditions: A student logs in to the OAP Fusion ERP system, has a valid leave request template, and is authorized to submit it
action_or_input: View the current status of own leave requests via the OAP Fusion ERP system using the provided interface
expected_result: The student can view a list of their current leave requests, including the status, start date, end date, and any other relevant information

purpose: Test the student viewing history of previous leave requests
preconditions: A student logs in to the OAP Fusion ERP system, has a valid leave request template, and is authorized to submit it
action_or_input: View the history of previous leave requests via the OAP Fusion ERP system using the provided interface
expected_result: The student can view a list of their past leave requests, including the status, start date, end date, and any other relevant information

purpose: Verifies that a student submits a bonafide certificate request specifying the purpose.
preconditions: A student has registered with the system and is logged in.
action_or_input: POST /bonafide/certificate
expected_result: The system receives the bonafide certificate request with the specified purpose.

purpose: Verifies that a bonafide request is routed to the Academic Administrator.
preconditions: A student has submitted a bonafide certificate request.
action_or_input: Route the bonafide certificate request to the Academic Administrator.
expected_result: The bonafide certificate request is routed to the Academic Administrator.

purpose: Verifies that the Academic Administrator verifies the student's academic standing.
preconditions: A student has submitted a bonafide certificate request, and the Academic Administrator has access to the student's academic data.
action_or_input: The Academic Administrator verifies the student's academic standing.
expected_result: The Academic Administrator records the student's academic standing.

purpose: Verifies that the Academic Administrator makes a decision to approve or reject the bonafide certificate request.
preconditions: A student has submitted a bonafide certificate request, and the Academic Administrator has access to the student's academic data and decision-making criteria.
action_or_input: The Academic Administrator makes a decision to approve or reject the bonafide certificate request.
expected_result: The Academic Administrator records the decision.

purpose: Verifies that the student can track the status of their bonafide certificate request.
preconditions: A student has submitted a bonafide certificate request, and the system has generated a unique request ID.
action_or_input: The student queries the system to track the status of their bonafide certificate request.
expected_result: The system provides the status of the bonafide certificate request.

purpose: Verifies that the student can download an approved bonafide certificate with a certificate number.
preconditions: A student has submitted a bonafide certificate request, the Academic Administrator has approved it, and the system has generated a unique request ID.
action_or_input: The student downloads the approved bonafide certificate.
expected_result: The student receives the approved bonafide certificate with a certificate number.

purpose: Verify that a PG student can submit a monthly assistantship claim with the correct hours rendered.

preconditions.status: PG student is registered and has completed the necessary course work.
preconditions.hours_rendered: The hours for the assistantship claim have been rendered by the professor.

action_or_input: A PG student submits a monthly assistantship claim through the system.

expected_result.message: The system has processed the claim and assigned it to the student.

purpose: Verify that a submitted claim can be verified by the assigned Thesis Supervisor.

preconditions.claim_id: The claim ID generated by the system after submission.
preconditions.supervisor: The assigned Thesis Supervisor has logged in to the system.

action_or_input: The assigned Thesis Supervisor verifies the claim by logging into the system and accessing the claim details.

expected_result.message: The system has processed the verification request and has verified the claim.

purpose: Verify that a submitted claim can be verified by the assigned TA Supervisor.

preconditions.claim_id: The claim ID generated by the system after submission.
preconditions.supervisor: The assigned TA Supervisor has logged in to the system.

action_or_input: The assigned TA Supervisor verifies the claim by logging into the system and accessing the claim details.

expected_result.message: The system has processed the verification request and has verified the claim.

purpose: Verify that a department administrator can review and forward a submitted assistantship claim to the HoD.

preconditions.claim_id: The claim ID generated by the system after submission.
preconditions.admin: A department administrator has logged in to the system.
preconditions.ho_d: The HoD is assigned to the department administrator and is logged in to the system.

action_or_input: The department administrator reviews the claim and forwards it to the HoD.

expected_result.message: The system has processed the forwarding request and forwarded the claim to the HoD.

purpose: Verify that the HoD can approve or reject a forwarded assistantship claim.

preconditions.claim_id: The claim ID generated by the system after submission.
preconditions.ho_d: The HoD is assigned to the department administrator and is logged in to the system.

action_or_input: The HoD approves or rejects the forwarded assistantship claim.

expected_result.message: The system has processed the approval/rejection request and updated the claim status.

purpose: Verify that an academic administrator can process stipend disbursement for approved assistantship claims.

preconditions.claim_id: The claim ID generated by the system after submission.
preconditions.admin: An academic administrator has logged in to the system.
preconditions.stipend: The stipend amount associated with the claim.

action_or_input: The academic administrator processes the stipend disbursement for the approved claim.

purpose: Verify that a PG student can request a graduate seminar schedule.

action_or_input: The PG student requests a graduate seminar schedule for the course.

expected_result.message: The system has processed the scheduling request and assigned the seminar to the student.

purpose: Verify that a department administrator can schedule a graduate seminar with the correct details.

preconditions.admin: A department administrator has logged in to the system.
preconditions.seminar: A seminar that the department administrator has scheduled.

action_or_input: The department administrator schedules the graduate seminar with the correct details.

purpose: Verify that students and faculty can view graduate seminar schedules.

preconditions.students: All students registered for the seminar.
